comment: No family is given for any jack: the module multiplies whatever it is handed, so no one colour is true of these ports. The two IN1 jacks are the ones the maker names Multiplier and the two IN2 jacks the ones he names Multiplicant; only the IN1 pair is normalled. Index order is not panel order here — inputs 0 and 2 are the upper section, inputs 1 and 3 the lower, so the panel reads 0, 2, 1, 3 from the top.
